lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Rb2Hf crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Hf centers as octahedrally coordinated by six Rb neighbors, while Rb centers show either six Hf neighbors or three Hf and three Rb neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all six sites, and polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Hf octahedra and between Hf and Rb polyhedra, with Rb–Rb polyhedra also showing edge-sharing.
